summary: Two snowmobilers triggered a D2 hard-slab avalanche in Mountain Boy Gulch south of Independence Pass; the caught rider was carried through trees and broke both legs; his companion splinted and evacuated him and Flight for Life airlifted him to a hospital.
location: Mountain Boy Gulch, south of Independence Pass
notes: SnowBrains story (opened) quotes the full CAIC report: riders met at the Hwy 82 winter closure on the east side of Independence Pass, rode from the Brumley townsite into Mountain Boy Gulch; ~4 PM slide released above Rider 2, carried him through trees, both legs broken; Rider 1 splinted the legs, they self-evacuated by snowmobile, he called 911 after reaching cell service, Flight for Life landed on Hwy 82 and evacuated Rider 2. East side of Independence Pass / Brumley = Lake County; no county SAR team reported in the account.
